context.body: Gift, sending, salvation, judgment, belief, and moral exposure are linked.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: God’s love gives the only Son for life, sends him not to condemn but to save, while judgment appears through response to light.
observations.label: God loves and sends the Son: action

observations.body: People either believe and come to light or love darkness because their works are evil.
observations.label: God loves and sends the Son: response

observations.body: God so loved · gave · sent · light · judgment
observations.label: Words in John 3:16–21

payload.posture: Read John 3:16–21 as jesus and god evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage attributes saving purpose to sending without claiming that no judgment remains.
payload.title: God loves and sends the Son
